transcript: Sharon Osborn lost so much weight that she admitted she could barely recognize her own face. After using Osempic, Sharon said she became too gaunt and even struggled to regain weight. Fans immediately noticed her hollow cheeks, sharper jawline, and dramatic loss of facial volume. One of the most talked about examples of what's now called Osempic face. Then there's Whoopi Goldberg. Whoopi openly admitted she used Monjaro after her weight reached nearly 300 pounds. Her transformation shocked fans, but it also sparked conversations about how rapid weight loss can dramatically change facial appearance. Next is Kathy Bates. Kathy lost around 100 pounds and later explained that while Osempic helped, it wasn't the whole story. Fans immediately noticed her face looked much slimmer with more defined features and less facial volume than before. Then there's Rosie O'Donnell. Rosie revealed she was using Monjaro and said it completely changed her appetite. As the weight came off, fans also noticed a much leaner, more angular appearance compared to previous years. Joy Behar also surprised viewers. After revealing she lost around 25 pounds using Osempic, fans began comparing before and after photos pointing to a noticeably slimmer face alongside her weight loss. And finally, Kelly Osbourne. Kelly has repeatedly denied using Osempic for her weight loss, but her dramatically slimmer appearance has fueled non-stop online speculation. Fans continue debating her transformation every time new photos surface. Even though she has pushed back against the rumors. But here's what most people don't realize. Osempic face isn't actually caused by the medication itself. Doctors say it's the result of rapid weight loss, which can reduce facial fat, making cheeks appear hollow and facial features look more defined or older. The same effect can happen after any significant weight loss, not just with GLP1 medications.
